name: JK Ren'ai Shousetsuka ~Anata ga Oshieru H na Ren'ai Shinan~
original_name: JK恋愛小説家 ～アナタが教えるHな恋愛指南～
source:
I'm a student whose reasons for joining the literature club were basically arbitrary - since club participation was mandatory. But unlike the majority of other students, I didn't become a ghost member. The reason was... to put it bluntly, a [b]girl[/b].

I show up at the clubroom almost every day to see the club president, Wakana Izumi - the only one there actually doing anything resembling club activities. The other guys probably haven't noticed, but this literary girl president has a damn good figure. How did I manage to notice? It's because when she's writing novels, her guard is down; once she concentrates, she seems to lose track of her surroundings... maybe because of the heat, but she ends up undoing her uniform to a risqué degree, letting me savor that outstanding figure.

And so, my daily presence in the clubroom earned me a reputation as a serious, committed member - and the club president came to think highly of me.

Then one day, she asked me for a favor.

She wanted me to teach her about "love". The theme of the newcomers' literary award the president was aiming for was a "romance novel", and since she had no experience with "love", she turned to me - the closest person of the opposite sex.

Honestly, that left me stuck. What even [i]is[/i] love, anyway? Asking someone whose years without a girlfriend equals his age - does a correct answer even exist in the first place? I was about to respectfully decline... when it clicked.

If there's no right answer... then whatever I teach her can't exactly be wrong. In other words, even my arbitrary responses would count as answering the president's request.
This is a chance. I decided to teach her about "love" in my own way.
...After all, when it comes to "love", experience is what really matters, right?

Even if it's something lewd - you can't understand it without experiencing it with your body!

[Translated from the [url=http://www.digianime.co.jp/redrebel/product/ren/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
由于学校硬性规定人人必须参加社团，我当初纯粹是随手乱填才加入了文艺社。但与绝大多数挂名社员不同，我并没有沦为幽灵社员。至于原因嘛……打开天窗说亮话，当然是为了[b]女孩子[/b]。

我几乎每天都会准时去活动室报到，只为见社长若菜泉一面——整个社团里也只有她一个人在正儿八经地开展社团活动。其他男生八成还没察觉到，这位文学少女社长的身材其实火辣得要命。至于我是怎么发现的？那是因为她一旦动笔写起小说就会彻底卸下防备，全神贯注之下完全注意不到周围的动静……也不知是不是天热的缘故，她总是不知不觉把校服解开到走光的危险边缘，让我得以尽情饱览那副傲人的曼妙身段。

就这样，每天雷打不动往活动室跑的我赢得了“认真负责的好社员”的美名，社长也对我格外器重。

直到某一天，她向我提出了一个请求。

她希望我教她什么是“恋爱”。原来社长正准备冲击新人文学奖，而本届征文主题偏偏是“恋爱小说”；毫无恋爱经验的她走投无路，便把求助的目光投向了身边距离最近的异性——也就是我。

老实说，这可把我难住了。说到底，恋爱究竟[i]是[/i]什么玩意儿啊？跑来问我这个单身年数等于年龄的母胎单身汉，这世上真有标准答案吗？就在我正准备婉言谢绝的瞬间……脑海中突然灵光一闪。

既然世上本就没有标准答案……那无论我教她什么，都算不上错吧？换句话说，哪怕是我随心所欲胡诌出来的花样，也一样算是回应了社长的请求。
机会来了。我当即决定，用我自己的方式向她传授何为“恋爱”。
……毕竟说到“恋爱”，最重要的还是亲身体验嘛，对吧？

哪怕是色色的事情——不用身体亲自体验一番，又怎么可能真正明白呢！

[译自[url=http://www.digianime.co.jp/redrebel/product/ren/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
